title: Regroup the CLI around status, story and run, modelled on gh

steps.reason: Spec written: gh-style CLI tree (status / story / run / setup / background / agent), B1–B71 with examples, out of scope, no open questions. Key decisions: noun stays story until #74; status = inbox+cockpit with one-time notice; no aliases; run cancel parks; story close/reopen; story create stops at intake; config set/unset --user|--repo (#64 to build on it).

Plan agreed with the person: seams S1 runCli harness (+ interaction fake), S2 old-name repo lint, S3 remote contract; coverage for B1–B71; 3 prefactors (noun–verb framework, one printed-commands module, take restore extracted); D1–D9 (cancel = human stuck receipt, story view = orient JSON extended, prompts only TTY+no --json+not agent). B41/B51/B70 wording amended.

15 slices cover B1–B71: 01 noun–verb tree + run list/view, 02 printed-commands module (parallel), 03 targets+prompts, 04–13 per-noun verbs moving old commands (D1), 14 printed-command rename + full help, 15 docs/plugin/PRD + lint. Story criteria B1–B71 added. Open call in slice 05: cockpit --json lands at status --watch --json.
approve

units.title: Regroup the CLI around status, story and run, modelled on gh
Noun–verb command tree, with run list and run view
One module builds every command norn prints
Targets from the worktree, and terminal prompts
norn status shows what needs you; the listing moves to story list
status --watch replaces the cockpit; run attach
story view and story chat replace status <key> and orient
story answer, approve, reject and update-branch
story create, with the remote's createIssue
config list, get, set and unset
Printed commands use the new names; help shows the whole tree
Docs, skills, Herdr plugin and PRD on the new names, held by a lint
